# SECTION A — x86_64 frame instructions, r7900x, valgrind callgrind, photo_cid
# 512x512 raw yuv, qp 40. Every row byte-identical to C (ident=Y, and each
# instrumented run's own .obu cmp-clean against the uninstrumented pre-pass).
# SECTION B — x86_64 per-function SELF Ir (callgrind_annotate), same runs.
# fn = the port's `variance::sse` family or C's spatial-full-distortion family.
# SECTION C — GOT-resolved static `panic_bounds_check` call-site census.
# Naive `objdump | grep panic_bounds_check` reads ZERO on this PIE binary; the
# calls are `call *0x..(%rip)` and the GOT slot must be resolved from its
# SECTION D — aarch64 KERNEL BENCH (M4 Pro, benches/kernel_tiers.rs, three
# alternating runs of each build, ns/call). BOTH aarch64 candidates were
# REVERTED; the landed tree's aarch64 arms are source-identical to 7ec5b557.
# D1 = hand NEON arm vs the all-generic #[magetypes] body.
# D2 = hand NEON arm vs the same arm plus memory-staged row packing.
# SECTION E — memory, r7900x, tools/mem_bisect.sh round-robin, 0 refused.
# heap = heaptrack peak LIVE malloc'd bytes (one encode, deterministic).
# SECTION F — the LANDED tree (after the aarch64 revert) re-measured on x86,
# to show the revert did not move the x86 result. Same driver, same cell.
# SECTION G — wall clock, r7900x, tools/perf_ab.sh, 21 interleaved paired
# rounds, neither side niced, quiet box (load 0.17, top process 3.2 % CPU),
# every row ident=Y. The CONTROL is the base against a BYTE COPY of itself and
